newsitem.title: UK: Century Inns buys 78 pubs, sets rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Century Inns buys 78 pubs, sets rights issue.

text.p: British pub company Century Inns Plc said on Friday it agreed to buy 78 managed houses and other assets from Pubmaster for about 35.1 million stg in cash.
Century also said it would raise about 19.0 million stg net through a one-for-three rights issue of up to 13.18 million new ordinary shares at 155p per share.
The company said it expected the acquisition to enhance earnings per share in the first full financial year after completion of the deal.
In addition to the 35.1 million stg payment, Century said it would pay not more than 900,000 stg for certain other Pubmaster assets.
Pubmaster was bought late last year by a group owned by NatWest Ventures, Prudential Ventures, HSBC Holdings and the Bank of Scotland.
Century Inns, which has 400 tenanted pubs and 23 managed houses, mostly in north eastern England, said the acquisition would extend its geographic spread into the southeast and East Anglia.
The rights issue was fully underwritten by NM Rothschild. UBS were the brokers to the issue. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
